mechanism.name: bounded two-step causal option with witnessed return prevention
mechanism.mechanismLogic: At each step, calculate unchanged R3 chosen action first; only if R3 is a TURN and the learned 2-step public goal-progress posterior of the same-turn+forward option is below alternate-turn+forward by >=0.5 and chosen alternate-turn+forward has predicted goal progress >=0.5, select opposite turn and commit one FORWARD action if subsequent real source public front is unblocked. Never alter an R3 forward. Abort pending forward on front-blocked or terminal. Do not choose an opposite turn if the previous observed action was the opposite turn at the same physical pose, to avoid reversing into a stationary two-step loop. Always feed actual action and actual source consequence into R3; retain only source-observed public history. Never use original full grid or any unselected fork during evaluation.
mechanism.optionColdRestart: frozen trained option models plus episode-local last source action/pose and pending actual forward have authenticated snapshot after three actual source steps, restore from genuinely separate OS process and verify next chosen action
mechanism.sourcePredictions: true physically executed source two-action signed goal-Manhattan progress, conditional by family/public-front/heading/pair with shrinkage sixteen to FIT-trained real pair prior; conventional learned ridge predicts same true signed progress using full public x/y/goal/heading/front and pair one-hot
